cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'project'); sys.path.insert(0,'dev')
from request import load
from collector import Case, PRIM_INDEX
from ref import Ref
req = load(open('/tmp/allkinds.json','rb').read())
bad = 0
for case in req['cases']:
    m = Case(PRIM_INDEX[case['primitive']], case['mode'], case['root'],
             case['segments'], case['words'], case['capacity'], case['start'],
             case.get('trace', 0))
    m.replay(case['events'])
    got = m.certificate()
    r = Ref(case['primitive'], case['mode'], case['root'], case['segments'],
            case['words'], case['capacity'], case['start'], case.get('trace', 0))
    r.replay(case['events'])
    exp = r.certificate()
    same = got == exp
    print('%-13s m%d match=%s' % (case['primitive'], case['mode'], same))
    if not same:
        bad += 1
        for k in exp:
            if got.get(k) != exp[k]:
                print('   ', k, json.dumps(got.get(k))[:300], '!=', json.dumps(exp[k])[:300])
print('mismatches', bad)
EOF
